name: Личные разделы

findingsAndFixes.finding: Pages created objects with default false personal like/bookmark flags; caching a detail outside the main feed could show incorrect actions.
findingsAndFixes.fix: Load the current user’s bounded like/bookmark sets before building objects; retain canonical membership state.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Up to 20 organization content queries ran sequentially for one page.
findingsAndFixes.fix: Normal path resolves organizations in batches of ten; preserve per-target permission fallback and unavailable markers.
findingsAndFixes.performanceEvidence: Source request structure, not a measured production latency claim; document reads are not claimed to decrease.

findingsAndFixes.finding: The view ran loadIfNeeded and refreshIfStale consecutively. An initial failure immediately started a second request and replaced its retry UI.
findingsAndFixes.fix: Use refreshIfStale as the single entry point; it already handles an initial load.
findingsAndFixes.reproduction: The extended retry UI scenario failed because registrations.retry vanished, then passed after removing the duplicated call.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Reading history waited for acknowledgement of queued writes, including sequential retries after failure.
findingsAndFixes.fix: Publish the bounded read before synchronizing pending writes; coalesce synchronization within the session and stop the retry pass on the first failure, keeping undelivered entries persisted.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Saved search could describe an empty collection despite nonempty saved data. Subscription matching retained surrounding whitespace; refresh errors could lack an explicit retry or disappear under a no-match filter.
findingsAndFixes.fix: Separate no-match copy, normalize subscription queries, retain errors and retry actions with loaded rows or an empty filtered result.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Recent-view thumbnails squeezed large titles; compact confirmation popovers severely wrapped German explanatory text.
findingsAndFixes.fix: Give accessibility titles their own full-width row; use standard centered alerts with explicit cancellation for history deletion/clear and subscription removal.

findingsAndFixes.finding: The private-content entry point rendered an indefinite progress indicator for a guest. Checking only absence of private routes initially missed this unusable positive state.
findingsAndFixes.fix: Add a localized guest card with sign-in and account creation, verified cancellation/return, clear primary/secondary contrast, and no private routes.

roles.policyMatrix: All five personal routes × supported platform roles × every AccountStatus/UserBlockState; guest denied. Organization roles do not change personal query ownership.
roles.detailActionBasis: Detailed mutation journeys use isolated owner fixtures; per-user authorization is checked independently in Firestore Rules with ordinary member/cross-user contexts. No claim that every action/theme/role Cartesian combination was executed.

dataFlows.saved: users/{uid}/{news,event,organization}Bookmarks → bounded resolution → own unsave → activity record → shared feed reconciliation
dataFlows.subscriptions: own likes markers → approved organization resolution and personal flags → unsubscribe → confirmation → persisted readback
dataFlows.registrations: own registrations → approved organization events → canonical register/unregister callable → shared membership/count/reminder update
dataFlows.recent: detail recording → users/{uid}/recentViews → latest 30 → deletion/clear with cutoffs; primary content retained
dataFlows.activity: acknowledged action → persistent outbox → own activityLog → latest 100; clear/delete does not undo the action

verification.emptyStateNote: Two other harness failures in this bundle were investigated; later bundles contain the corrected cases.
verification.deniedNote: The later guest scenario adds a positive guest UI and authentication navigation assertion.
verification.unitNote: Only the 95 unit tests passed in this bundle; two guest UI identifier failures were resolved and rerun in dialogs-and-guest. The parent container identifier had overridden child identifiers.

rules.environment: Isolated Firestore Emulator; no production user data mutated

verification.localizations: de/uk validation passed; 3291 entries and Swift references

finalCapture.note: Final compiled sources; loading/error/retry of all five sections and guest German dark accessibility-size UI after the contrast correction.

video.origin: Actual XCTest simulator capture; includes test device startup and between-scenario relaunches.
video.observed: Saved loading → readable error/retry → acknowledged data → return to profile. No near-white frame in this sampled dark-theme window; no misleading empty-state flash observed in the reviewed contact. This is not a universal no-flicker guarantee.

verification.uniqueUIScenariosNote: Distinct scenario methods; repeated runs are not added to this count. Role scenario traverses five sections for eight active role variants.
verification.ci: Pending push/readback; hosted checks are distinct from local results.

productDecisions: Keep the five sections separate: current saved/subscription/registration membership differs from recent opens and historical actions.
Keep clear limits/partial-page explanations; search/sort/counters apply to loaded records while more pages remain. No false global totals.
Do not add administration tools or send-self support actions to personal sections.

delivery.source: implemented and locally verified; committed separately from preserved pre-existing project/catalog changes
delivery.testFlight: No new binary uploaded for block 4. Existing TestFlight 120 does not contain these changes.

boundaries: Simulator fixtures and Emulator Rules checks do not prove a live two-account production round trip.
Nested content details are covered here for correct target and personal actions; full editors/comments/recommendations remain in blocks 5–10.
Android source and delivered store binaries were not changed.
Pre-existing project reorder and Localizable.xcstrings changes preserved outside focused commits.
